project_metadata.project_name: SmartHR - Single-File In-Browser HRMS & Timekeeping System
project_metadata.architecture: Single-File In-Browser Backend (React + TypeScript + Web Worker + Dexie.js + ONNX Runtime Web Hybrid CDN)
project_metadata.current_phase: Phase 8: Architecture Review Fixes Applied (FORMULA_DEFS single source, dynamic calendar 21-20/1-31, worker pool 3/3, hybrid OCR REAL_ONNX+fallback, dynamic RBAC from Dexie, Vitest 32 tests green)

agent_profile.role: Senior Principal System Designer & Staff IT Software Engineer
rules: Evidence-First: Zero code fabrication without ground truth
No decision on ambiguous data; clarify with user before coding
Zero Native Browser Dialogs (Custom UI Toast/Modal Only)

source_files.chot_cong_template: /workspaces/HR-System/KIỂM TRA CHÔT CÔNG THÁNG 08.2026.xlsx (Sheets: Working time, Overtime, OT1, Thai san, Leave, Sheet1)
source_files.ui_kit_figma: /workspaces/HR-System/SmartHR - Free Figma UI Kit for HRM & Employee Management (Community).fig

user_confirmed_rules.overtime_rounding: Exact calculation without rounding blocks (e.g. 23 mins = 23/60 = 0.38h, exact standard overtime)
user_confirmed_rules.annual_leave_quota: Fully flexible: configurable upon creation and editable by HR Manager role
user_confirmed_rules.diligence_reduction_rules: Default applies company-wide, but fully customizable per department or employee class module

features: FORMULA_DEFS single source (formula-defs.ts) đồng bộ JS engine + Excel COUNTIF, hết drift
Dynamic calendar headers theo month/year (calendar-utils.ts), hỗ trợ cả chu kỳ SEASONAL 1-31 và OFFICIAL 21-20 (UI + Excel export)
Web Worker pool đủ 3/3 theo Plan.md: timesheet-parser + formula-engine.worker + onnx-ocr.worker
Hybrid ONNX: model check HEAD request thật + ORT runtime load từ CDN runtime-side (không bundle, giữ index.html ~2MB), fallback preset minh bạch REAL_ONNX/SIMULATION_FALLBACK
RBAC dynamic: hasPermission đọc rolePermissions từ Dexie settings (persist qua SettingsPage), không còn hard-code
Diligence rules per-department được áp dụng thật trong TimesheetCalendarPage
Vitest 32 tests pass (formula-engine, ocr-table-engine normalizers, calendar-utils)
12h Shift Rest Violation Alert with CTA
Cell Status Badges (W, N, Off, AL, UL, SL)
3 States (Pending Yellow, Matched Green, Mismatch Red)
AL Quota Enforcement (reject & alert if exhausted)
Leave types: AL, UL, SL, PL, BT, Maternity
Dynamic Permission Matrix for AD System
Web Worker Stream Chunking for 20k rows
ExcelJS Styled Exporter with Leggett.jpg logo and formulas
